hebrewText: וְ/שָׁפַכְתִּ֣י חֲמָתִ֔/י עַל סִ֖ין מָע֣וֹז מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֖י אֶת הֲמ֥וֹן נֹֽא

tokens.bdb: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
tokens.kjv: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

tokens.bdb: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
tokens.kjv: anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(-ful). See H2529 (חֶמְאָה).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and (probably) desert adjoining
tokens.ptLiteralWord: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
tokens.enLiteralWord: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
tokens.explanation: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
tokens.explanationEn: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining

tokens.bdb: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
tokens.kjv: force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), ([idiom] most) strong (hold).

tokens.bdb: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
tokens.explanation: Mitsrayim — Egito. A terra das "duas margens" do Nilo

tokens.bdb: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
tokens.kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a noise, tumult, crowd; also disquietude, wealth
tokens.kjv: abundance, company, many, multitude, multiply, noise, riches, rumbling, sounding, store, tumult.

tokens.bdb: No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt
